title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Off record, I am just curious: What happens to coaches pay during these times?

So far we’re getting paid, not sure what will happen if the season is cancelled. I know all the coaches contract runs out after this season, not sure what to expect. I guess it’s like everything going on,nobody knows

Ok. Because I didn’t know about the pay and I know nobody wants no baseball so I didn’t want to say “good,” but given the contract situation and where the team is at, I feel like there could be a silver lining for you guys
1) You get a whole year away from another losing season - that grinds, especially for 3 straight years -and 2) You could get a pretty darn good team next year
It just changes things a bit. They can’t be holding those pitchers back long
If at all. But yeah, was just thinking about it. How’s everything going where you’re at, saw Arizona was getting higher
It’s got be getting close to their time. Yea the virus is on the rise here,people being crazy, not good
Yeah. Remember when they were gonna play the whole season there
Wow, I’m not so sure if the virus continues to spread if there will be baseball this season. I know both sides aren’t even close to an agreement too
